name: Delta-star transformer
summary: A delta-star transformer provides a delta-connected winding and a star-connected winding.
description: A delta-star transformer provides a delta-connected winding and a star-connected winding. Where the star point is brought out, its neutral and earthing arrangement are separate drawing requirements.
readingNotes: Do not infer a grounded neutral merely from a star winding.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A star winding can exist without an accessible or earthed neutral terminal.
